_help: Judgment calls live here, each with a reason and where the evidence is. Edit, add or delete rules freely, then run build_playbook.py. scope: opp (team name or *), map (map name or *), side (first, second or *). kinds: pick_bonus {heroes}, ban_bonus {heroes}, ban_discount {heroes: multiplier below 1}, ranged_target {min and or max}, min_marksmen {n}, note {text}, damage_first {players, pairs}: the hero pairs for our two damage players in order of preference; the first pair whose heroes are all open (or already ours) is the plan, its 'order' heroes are locked before the opponent's round two ban (weight damage_first), 'later' heroes can wait, an 'option' pair is shown as the alternative to the pair before it.

rules.why: RETIRED 2026-10-14. The Division C West sample (13-6 for teams with two or more marksmen, 19 games) is contradicted by 16,500 NGS league sides: two or more marksmen won 47% over 2,328 sides (46% in the newest three seasons), none or one won 50 to 51%. The rule no longer adds a marksman bonus or a warning.

RETIRED 2026-10-14: written on a division sample and on the old ranged count (Heroes Profile attack type, which counted ranged healers). Ranged now means a ranged damage dealer from the hero profile. League wide, 3 or more ranged damage dealers won 40% over 358 sides and 0 to 2 won 50%, on every map; see data.comps and E.rangedLeague. Original note: Tomb: 8-4 with three or more ranged heroes and 2-6 with two or fewer. Icy Veins wants poke for the objective and high wave clear.

CCS is 4-6 against Brightwing or Anduin teams and 12-1 against every other healer (through Oct 14). We are 2-1 with Brightwing against them and 0-3 with Rehgar or Stukov.
Johanna is their favorite first pick (4 times, Valkamer 6-1) and counters our Tychus and Brightwing. Lunara is WitsEnd's 8-3 hero and a second marksman.
UnicycleYay is 2-3 on Qhira (4.0 deaths a game) and 12-3 on everything else. Banning her sends him to Sylvanas, Hanzo or Tychus.
Ragnaros had 265k minion damage and 34k experience in the Garden loss. Chen and Stukov are our answers if it is open.
UnicycleYay Hanzo was in their Dragon Shire win over us.
UnicycleYay's highest damage hero (4.1k a minute).
ShadowDroid's clear and carry hero (5-1 for CCS).

rules.text: Damage first: CCS spends its bans on Hunter's and chelsi's heroes (Junkrat, Chromie, then Thrall or Tychus in round two) and has not banned our healer, tank or offlaner since the first game. Lock both damage players before their round two ban: slots 5 and 8 with first pick, 6 and 7 with second pick. Then healer, tank and offlaner.
rules.why: Their round two ban took Thrall or Tychus in 6 of 6 games against us, and we never had chelsi's hero locked before it. chelsi on Tychus or Thrall against them 2-1, on anything else 0-3.

pairs.note: Both best heroes. Sylvanas first: they took it at their first turn 2 of 5 times it was open against us. Tychus for chelsi denies a hero CCS is 5-0 on, and their round two ban then falls on Thrall.
Tychus is gone, so Thrall for chelsi.
Sylvanas is gone: lock both of chelsi's banned heroes in this turn. Hunter's Tychus is Storm League form (14-6 over the last year), one NGS game.
On wave clear maps (Tomb, Infernal Shrines): chelsi on Tychus now, Hunter on Orphea next turn. CCS has never banned or played Orphea, so it can wait.
Sylvanas and Tychus are gone: Thrall now, Orphea can wait.
They spent their bans on chelsi's heroes, so Junkrat is open for Hunter and chelsi takes Sylvanas.
They spent their bans on chelsi's heroes, so Chromie is open for Hunter and chelsi takes Sylvanas.
Tychus and Thrall are both gone: chelsi goes to Tassadar (or Gul'dan), not to Sylvanas.
Nothing contested is left for either of you. Neither hero has been banned by CCS against us.

rules.why: In the six games against CCS chelsi's hero was never locked before their round two ban, which took Thrall or Tychus every time. Both of you on your best heroes this season: 9-2. Neither: 1-4.
In Season 22 NGS: SilverJackal is 8-2 on Kael'thas, Nae 6-1 on Anub'arak, Imbuement 6-0 on Greymane.
Cosmos is 4-0 with Johanna. Taking it is a denial. Cosmos struggles into Muradin and Stitches comps.
